column3: “Doom” is supplied to the time of nations.
“Out of complacency” renders secure Cush; “doom” specifies Egypt’s day.
“Judgment” renders plural judgments; Thebes identifies No.
Pelusium identifies Sin, and Thebes identifies No.
Pelusium and Thebes identify Sin and No; “daily” renders in daytime.
Darkening renders withholding the day; yoke renders yoke-bars.
“Splinted” specifies the binding with a bandage.
“Like a mortally wounded man” renders the groans of one fatally wounded.
“Fall limp” specifies falling; wields renders stretches out.
